gems.name: SH_1
gems.description: The output of this GEM consists of images in the Minimalist Art style. Material & Strokes: Charcoal & Pencil Sketch: Strokes are handcrafted, rustic, and preserve the characteristic grainy, dusty texture of graphite. Color & Space: Grayscale on Bright Canvas: The entire image uses the black and white tones of graphite, placed on a bright white, airy paper background. Overall feeling (Vibe): at its core, uses only two colors, black and white.

gems.name: SH_2
gems.description: The output of this GEM consists of images in the Minimalist Art style. Material & Brushstrokes: Pencil & Charcoal Sketch: Strokes are handcrafted, rustic, and have the rough texture of graphite charcoal. Color & Space: Primary color palette: Use Neutral & Warm Earthy tones (#F2D2C2, #C6A894, #6D6E71) instead of pure white for the background. Emotional customization color system: Dramatic (Strong): High contrast, deep shadows, sharp shading, accented with diffused golden light (Golden Highlights - 2700K), Contemplative (Soft): Low contrast, atmospheric shadowing, diffused light, using Mellow Greens tones, Transition: Ivory & Light Beige negative space, replacing characters with artistic handwriting Typography or abstract patterns. Overall feeling (Vibe) Atmospheric & Healing: Bringing a sense of contemplation, safety, and deep motivation.

gems.name: SH_3
gems.description:
The output of this GEM consists of images in the Minimalist Sketchbook Doodle style:

Material & Brushstrokes: Looks like hand-drawn doodles using ballpoint pen or thin felt-tip pen on rough sketchbook paper or faded lined paper. The strokes intentionally retain a slight shake, appearing somewhat scribbled and handcrafted.

Color & Space: * When the quote is strong/decisive: Bold, decisive ink strokes combined with warm golden light (Golden Highlights) as accents.

When the quote is gentle/contemplative: Slender strokes, plenty of empty space (negative space) on paper with soothing tones (light moss green, warm earthy colors, ivory).

When it is a transition sentence (no character): The scene transforms into notebook margin doodles (spirals, leaves, wavy lines) or artistic rustic handwriting.

Overall feeling (Vibe): Minimalist, intimate, safe, and deeply personal—like you are flipping through the diary of someone who always carries positive energy.
